items.title: Path masks: edge pixels come out darker where a stroke's outlines overlap (zeno adds coverage there): up to 0.7 of a pixel's coverage, visible as slightly heavy inner edges at 48 dp
items.kind: quality (native graphics; path rasterisation) — owner's eye
items.discussion: found by the Lucide sweep (lane lucide-s4, Order 58, 2026-11-13); image `proposals/projects/vilan/proposal/gfx-path-images/sweep-grape-48-ours-reference-difference.png` (ours, tiny-skia, difference); within the sweep's bounds, so not a failure
items.body: Sweep of all 1,999 Lucide icons against tiny-skia (mean absolute coverage difference over inked pixels): 16 dp average 0.051 / worst pixel 0.62; 24 dp 0.027 / 0.53; 48 dp 0.014 / 0.69. What is left after the two stroker fixes is this: zeno's stroker emits an outline whose pieces overlap (the two sides of a closed contour, joins, contours lying on each other in the icon), and the accumulation rasteriser ADDS partial coverages at an edge where they overlap, so such an edge pixel is darker than the union's true coverage. Seen as a slightly heavier inner edge on small closed shapes (`grape`, `shrink`, `server-off`, `columns-4`). It is a property of the rasteriser, not the stroker: tiny-skia's stroker would not change it. Against tiny-skia at 16x averaged down (the nearest thing to true coverage), ours is the CLOSER of the two on straight edges at 16 dp (`columns-4`: ours 0.040, tiny-skia 0.073), so this is not one-sided. OPTIONS, none tried: (a) accept (the integrator's recommendation for icon sizes; the eye does not find it at 16 to 24 dp); (b) rasterise a stroke's outline through a union first (a boolean pass, or a scanline rasteriser with a non-additive winding rule: tiny-skia as a real dependency for strokes, R2's named fallback; it adds no package on Linux but is newly compiled on Windows and macOS); (c) supersample stroke masks 2x vertically and average (masks are cached, so the cost is at first use). Related, R5's known gap stays: zeno bevels MITER joins sharper than 90 degrees; drawing the whole Lucide set with miter joins put 56 icons up to a whole pixel off, so a set that uses miter joins needs (b) or a miter fix of our own in `stroke_outline`. Lucide itself uses round joins and caps throughout and is not touched by it.

items.title: Icon packages after S4: users outside a clone cannot get `vilan/packages/lucide`, a declared dependency is analysed whole (+21% check instructions), and two tool gaps the package met
items.discussion: lane lucide-s4 (Order 58, 2026-11-13, a7ea9738); the package location `vilan/packages/lucide` is the integrator's default under R11 (`outside std`), owner may overrule
items.area: vilan/packages/lucide, scripts/lucide-native.mjs, release packaging (scripts/, .github/workflows/release.yml), crates/vilan-cli (check of a library, dependency diagnostics)
items.body: (1) DISTRIBUTION: nothing in the release ships `vilan/packages`; the std blob is `vilan/std` and `vilan/macro_std`, and the npm and tarball packages carry binaries. A program takes the package by a PATH dependency (`lucide = { path = "../../packages/lucide" }`), which works inside a clone only. How packages outside std reach users (a registry, git dependencies, vendoring into the release) is gfx-path.md's open section 8 question and the owner's design call. (2) COST: declaring the dependency raises `vilan check` from 0.29 s to 0.35 s, peak memory 110 MB to 134 MB and instructions by 21% (1.97 G to 2.37 G) even when nothing imports it, because a declared dependency is parsed and analysed whole (428 KB, 1,999 functions); the native binary pays only for icons used (five icons: 512 bytes). If it matters: one module per icon or per letter, or lazy analysis of unreferenced items in dependencies. (3) TOOL GAPS, not fixed: `vilan check <library dir>` checks only the platform contract, not types (a planted type error in the package passed; the package's test checks `src/lib.vl` on both backends instead); a missing name in a dependency is reported as `cannot find 'trash_2' in module 'src'` instead of naming `lucide`. (4) DECIDED IN LANE, owner may overrule: the pin is lucide-static 1.64.0 (the newest release at least two weeks old; tarball integrity in the generated header); the 276 deprecated alias names are left out; a keyword name gets a trailing `_`, a name starting with a digit the prefix `icon_`; the generated `lib.vl` is not formatter-stable and lives under the library's `generated` root; `examples.rs` staging keeps the repository layout and copies `vilan/packages` for a manifest that names it.
